node.statement: Let D_* be the universal maximum fixed in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger. Then D_* >= 1, and at base scale t the global scalar literal map u_0:C->A, u_0(lambda)=lambda I_A, furnished by lem-maincb-initial-raw-inclusion is an extended D_* t-inclusion with ||u_0(I_C)-I_A|| <= D_* t; lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger states that this call is eligible for lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation.
